title: Entities
description: A collection of entities representing organizations, people, and their relationships.

id.description: Unique identifier for this organization type.

name.description: The name of the organization type.

description.description: A brief description of the organization type.

organization.description: Represents a formal organization, such as a company, non-profit, or government body.

name.description: The legal name of the organization.

acronym.description: A short abbreviation or acronym for the organization.

description.description: A brief description of the organization.

creationDate.description: The date the organization was founded or created (YYYY-MM-DD).

contactInformation.description: A list of contact details for the organization.

geographicalLocations.description: A list of geographical locations associated with the organization.

items.description: A reference to a geographical location for an organization, with a description of its purpose.

geographicalEntityId.description: Reference to a geographical entity from the Geography schema.

description.description: A description of the organization's use of this location (e.g., 'Headquarters', 'Regional Office').

buildingLocations.description: A list of buildings associated with the organization.

items.description: A reference to a building for an organization, with a description of its purpose.

buildingId.description: Reference to a building from the Geography schema.

description.description: A description of the organization's use of this building (e.g., 'Main Campus', 'Data Center').

person.description: Represents an individual person, including their personal details and contact information.

contactInformation.description: A list of contact details for the person.

entityRelationshipType.description: Defines a type of relationship between entities, specifying the nature of the connection and the types of entities it can connect.

id.description: Unique identifier for this entity relationship type.

name.description: The name of the relationship type (e.g., 'Employment', 'Subsidiary').

description.description: A brief description of the relationship type.

sourceTypes.description: An array of allowed entity types for the source of this relationship.

targetTypes.description: An array of allowed entity types for the target of this relationship.

contactInformationType.description: Defines a type of contact information, such as email or phone number.

id.description: Unique identifier for this contact information type.

name.description: The name of the contact type (e.g., 'Email', 'Phone').

description.description: A brief description of the contact information type.

contactInformation.description: A specific piece of contact information for an entity.

value.description: The actual contact detail (e.g., the email address or phone number).

entityRelationship.description: Represents a connection or association between two entities.

id.description: Unique identifier for this entity relationship.

source.description: The origin entity of the relationship.

target.description: The destination entity of the relationship.

notes.description: A list of time-stamped notes about the relationship.

date.description: The date and time the note was created.

organizationTypes.description: A list of all defined organization types.

organizations.description: A list of all organizations in the digital twin.

people.description: A list of all people in the digital twin.

contactInformationTypes.description: A list of all defined contact information types.

entityRelationshipTypes.description: A list of all defined relationship types.

entityRelationships.description: A list of all relationships between entities.
